items:
Sweet Retreat on 30A has a fresh new look!

This beautiful 4-bed, 3.5-bath vacation home is located in the sought-after Magnolia Dune community in Seagrove Beach, offering Gulf views!

Multiple public beach accesses are just a short walk away! Enjoy the white-sand beaches and emerald waters of Seagrove Beach within seconds. Just steps from the community pool, this home is perfect for your next getaway.

This home was recently updated includes three king bedrooms, one on the first floor and two on the second, along with a built-in full-over-full bunk bedroom. The third-floor loft now includes two twin bunks and a loft providing even more space for guests to unwind. A convenient washer and dryer are also located upstairs.

Relax with all-new stylish furniture, whip up meals in the remodeled kitchen, and enjoy the updates to every bathroom, including a redesign of the primary. Plus, enjoy the convenience of parking for three vehicles and complimentary bikes to explore the scenic surroundings!

For added comfort, the home provides four beach chairs for guest use, conveniently stored in a closet, as well as a pack and play for families traveling with little ones.

This location is ideal for couples’ retreats, family vacations, reunions, and holidays. The 18+ mile scenic path stretching from Rosemary Beach to Dune Allen offers endless outdoor adventure, and the provided bikes make it even easier to take in the beauty of 30A.

If boutique shopping and first-class dining are on your list, 30A is full of charming shops, restaurants, and activities, all within walking distance or a short drive. With a lower price point than nearby Seaside, this home is an excellent choice for your next beach escape!

1st Floor
* Open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area
* Living room with a large flat-screen TV, sectional, and chair
* Dining area with seating for 8 plus counter seating for 6
* 1 King bedroom with TV and large closet
* Full bathroom with a newly upgraded walk-in shower
* Walkout to the community pool and your own gas grill

2nd Floor
* 1 King bedroom with TV, en-suite bath, and large closet
* 1 King bedroom with TV, shared bath, and large closet
* 1 Built-in Full-over-Full bunk bedroom with TV, shared bath and large closet
* Laundry room

3rd Floor
* Loft area with new two sets of twin bunk beds.
* 150 sq. ft. deck with seating and breathtaking Gulf views
* Half bathroom
* Private balcony
* Wet bar with mini fridge

Additional Features:
* 4 Bedrooms, 3.5 Bathrooms, Sleeps 14
* All-new stylish furniture and remodeled kitchen
* Steps from the beach
* Gulf views from the top floor
* Commercial outdoor grill on the first-floor deck
* Full-sized washer/dryer
* Parking for up to 3 vehicles
* 4 bikes through vacayzen.

Please Note:
The Magnolia Dune community pool will be closed from August 24 to August 28 for scheduled resurfacing and sealing. The pool will need time to cure and be refilled with water before reopening. We appreciate your understanding as these improvements are completed to ensure the best experience for future use.

*** A 20% discount will be automatically applied to stays that include any of the affected dates during the closure. ***

Your stay at Sweet Retreat includes Xplorie’s best activities, one ticket per day, per activity! Enjoy over $800 in nightly value, including golf at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, ziplining at Baytowne Adventure Zone, sailing on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise, Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and complimentary bike rentals for exploring 30A!

Please Note:
* A starter set of amenities is provided, including kitchen essentials, toiletries, and towels
* Pet Friendly: This property is pet friendly! If bringing a dog, please contact Reservations as an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. A maximum of 1 dog is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located in Seagrove Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near theme parks and near the beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside Beach. Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Jet skiing and scuba diving offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking/biking trails and cycling nearby.

The only rating below in which I did not give five stars was general condition because the pots and pans need to be replaced, but that is a minor gripe, and I would definitely stay here again.
